description: This file defines an Angular service 'ImageService' responsible for handling image-related operations such as upload, update, retrieval, conversion to data URLs, download, delete, export, and import within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ImageService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service for managing images, including uploading, updating, retrieving, converting, downloading, deleting, exporting, and importing images.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Uploads a new image with specified title and subtype.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Updates an existing image resource identified by type and key.

methods.name: updateImageInfo
methods.description: Updates metadata information of an image resource.

methods.name: updateImagePublicStatus
methods.description: Sets the public visibility status of an image resource.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of images with optional filters.

methods.name: getImageInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific image.

methods.name: getImageDataUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a data URL for an image, optionally as a string or sanitized URL.

methods.name: loadImageDataUrl
methods.description: Internal method to load image data as a URL or string.

methods.name: getImageString
methods.description: Converts an image URL to its base64 string representation.

methods.name: resolveImageUrl
methods.description: Resolves an image URL to a data URL or direct URL, handling resource URLs appropriately.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image resource, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: exportImage
methods.description: Exports image data for backup or transfer.

methods.name: importImage
methods.description: Imports image data into the system.
